messages:
Max: quick question — proposal for a protocol-linter + route-level fallback policy in the console.
Max: TL;DR: add a small linter that warns when proto <-> JSON shapes don't match, enforce a route policy field like `protocol: { prefer: \"grpc\", fallback: \"json\" }`, and surface a console toggle for rollouts.
Aya: +1. we've run into 415s from browser clients hitting gRPC-web when our shims missed a field.
Sam: Can we rely on auto-transcoding everywhere? curious about perf cost and telemetry gaps.
Liz: Console UX request: need a per-route banner showing "protocol policy" and a quick link to fix mismatches. Also a diff viewer for proto vs json mapping.
Max: quick linter example output:
```
WARN route /v1/complete: proto field response.choices: repeated vs JSON: object
Suggestion: either change proto schema or add jsonMapping: \"choices_as_array\"
```
Max: propose we run linter in CI and surface warnings in Console (Diagnostics tab) with a severity.
ops-bot: deploy:protocol-linter queued for canary (2 nodes) :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sam: fallback semantics question: browser-first -> JSON, internal services -> gRPC? or explicit per-route?
Aya: explicit per-route is safer. default can be `prefer: grpc fallback: json` but allow override.
Sam: agree. also: transcode overhead ~= 2-4ms p90 and small mem for buffers — measurable but acceptable if we avoid double-serialization for large payloads.
Max: noted perf cost. we should capture `protocol_used` and `fallback_used` in telemetry and add a `proto_mismatch_count` metric.
Liz: rollout UX: feature flag in Console, enable for 10% tenants, check telemetry for 24h bubbles, then escalate. show list of impacted routes with counts.
Sam: test plan: add e2e in `infra/protocol-tests` that asserts header-driven negotiation and fallback behavior, plus a smoke test for linter warnings.
Aya: SDK impact: browser SDK should default to JSON and prefer gRPC when explicitly configured. update docs/quickstarts.
Max: I'll draft an RFC and a small linter PR (go + proto libs). command to run locally: `./tools/protocol-lint check ./proto --json-output diagnostics.json`
Sam: +1. add an opt-in console annotation for "auto-transcode allowed" so customers can opt out if they want pure proto.
Max: thanks — I'll post the RFC link here once it's up and tag folks for review. :thumbsup:
Liz: can we also add a telemetry dashboard mock for the Console? I'll sketch one and drop in design channel.
Max: sounds good. tagging @Aya @Sam for review once RFC is up.
Aya: cool, will review.
Sam: thanks!
